BL-1792 — A headless closing-ceremony briefing's Recent git activity is one 17,316-character paragraph in the sent email: the composer emits bare lines with no list marker, CommonMark folds them into a single

, and a phone reader cannot see where one commit ends; the composer emits one Markdown list item per entry (Art Director brief 2026-09-28) What it solves: ## What is wrong Approval context: FIRM: the fix is in how compose-banked-briefing formats its line-per-entry sections (the brief's own constraint), not in markdown-to-html-lib or briefing_email_lib.bb, which already render a "- " list correctly (BL-1419). FIRM: the empty-section fallback lines and the ordinary coordinator/documente… BL-1792 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1792" (or "reject BL-1792 ") to act.
